documents.population: First-year applicants (requirements are the same for domestic and international applicants)
documents.notes: Harvard College Application Requirements and International Applicants pages. Not drafted: midyear school report (counselor; not needed if the school issues no midyear grades), the application fee or fee waiver, optional supplemental materials. Self-reported test scores are accepted; enrolling students submit official scores.

items.quote: Complete the Harvard Questions with the Common Application. This includes the following five required short-answer questions, each with a 150 word limit.
The secondary school report is a required form that is submitted by your school counselor or another school leader.
It includes the applicant's academic transcript(s), a letter of recommendation, and a school profile (if available).
Ask two teachers in different academic subjects who know you well to complete the Teacher Recommendation forms (which includes an evaluation form and a letter of recommendation).
Harvard requires the SAT or ACT to meet its standardized testing requirement.
Although you are not required to take an English proficiency exam (such as the TOEFL, IELTS, etc.), you may submit scores if you wish to do so.
If you choose to provide translated versions of your academic credentials or letters of recommendation, please note that you should not translate the documents yourself.
items.condition: you choose to provide translated versions of credentials or recommendation letters (not self-translated; the original must accompany it)
